title: Kalmar Ottawa electric yard truck gets to work in Canada
summary: Kalmar Ottawa has been a leader in diesel-powered yard trucks for decades, but as global logistics fleets move to reduce costs and insulate themselves from volatile diesel prices, the company is making that shift, too – and they’re out to prove their new, battery-electric T2 EV can deliver the same durability and productivity that’s made the original T2 a fixture at ports for years.

title: Met police break their own record for seizing illegal e-bikes
summary: London’s Metropolitan Police have already confiscated more illegal e-bikes and e-scooters in 2026 than during the entirety of last year, as authorities continue an aggressive enforcement campaign targeting illegally modified micromobility vehicles.

title: Another day at the office: Fortescue CEO test drives 150 ton haul truck [video]
summary: Industrial mining giants Fortescue have been leading the charge towards electrifying every aspect of their operations – and last week, the company’s CEO took some time to actually get out and test drive some of the company’s newest battery-powered heavy machines.

title: Windrose says 10 of its electric semi trucks are coming to Texas’ I-35 corridor
summary: The electric semi truck market seems to be heating up in Texas, with Wen Han’s upstart Windrose brand set to deploy 10 fully electric Class 8 trucks on the I-35 freight corridor between Dallas and Laredo en route to Mexico (but there are some caveats).

title: E-quipment highlight: Avant Tecno e727 electric wheel loader
summary: Increasingly volatile fuel prices are making electric equipment options a need, rather than a want for many fleets, and Avant Tecno is working to meet that need with the new e727 electric wheel loader – the company’s largest offering in North America.

title: Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats
summary: Waymo’s autonomous electric taxis crash 68% less than the average human driver, according to the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, with lower-severity crashes on average as well. But there are some important caveats that limit the data.

title: Land Rover’s fancy Freelander 8 EREV reveals high-tech, ultra-luxe interior
summary: The best seat in Jaguar Land Rover’s newest SUV might not be the one behind the steering wheel! New interior images of the Freelander 8 EREV revealed on Chinese social media show a six-seat, ultra-luxury luxury cabin that looks less “seats six,” and more G6.

title: Europe’s next-generation submarines are getting a lithium-ion battery upgrade
summary: European defense contractor Saft is set to supply lithium-ion battery systems for the next generation of naval submarines, replacing decades-old lead-acid technology with EV-style packs that promise higher energy density, faster charging, and superior underwater endurance.

title: Another state may legalize electric motorbikes up to 30 and 40 mph under sweeping new micromobility bill
summary: Massachusetts lawmakers are considering a new statewide framework for micromobility that could finally bring clearer rules to everything from e-bikes and e-scooters to higher-speed electric motorbikes capable of reaching 30 mph, 40 mph, and beyond.

title: Musk says Tesla to ‘open source’ Model S and X, but prior release makes us skeptical
summary:
Elon Musk says Tesla plans to “open source” the Model S and Model X, and he’s pointing to the original Roadster as the template.

The problem is Tesla’s Roadster release amounted to eight files on GitHub plus five document packages behind a login, with no open-source license attached to any of it.

title: EV Drivers Are Happier With Their Cars Than Gas Car Owners: Study
summary: Apparently, people who drive electric cars like just about everything more about their vehicles than gas-car drivers.

title: Tesla’s Controversial Door Handles Could Trigger New Safety Rules
summary: NHTSA said it would start working on rules around interior door releases in all vehicles.

title: Tesla Now Has Nearly 1.5 Million FSD Subscribers
summary: The company added 200,000 Full Self-Driving subscribers last quarter.

title: How Rivian Made The R2's Suspension Cheaper And Lighter Than The R1's But Just As Good
summary: Rivian went to impressive lengths to completely re-engineer the R2's battery and suspension to make the cheaper R2 as good as the R1.

title: Volkswagen's Cheapest EVs Are Already A Hit: 70,000 Orders And Counting
summary: The German group’s Electric Urban Car Family is “significantly exceeding expectations.”

title: A Bill Taking Aim At Chinese Cars In America Just Advanced In The Senate. It Could Hit Mercedes Too
summary: The Senate has moved forward legislation that would ban automakers with too much Chinese ownership.

title: Ford Is Switching To Apple Maps For Its Next-Gen EV Navigation
summary: Apple Maps in Ford's upcoming $30,000 electric truck will help with route planning and provide directions to Blue Cruise.

title: Subaru's Biggest EV Yet Just Got Delayed
summary: The American-made Getaway three-row SUV was supposed to go into production by the end of the year.

title: Tesla Sold 25% More Cars In Q2. Its Operating Profit Still Plummeted
summary: Record revenue and a big delivery rebound weren’t enough to offset lower vehicle margins and Tesla’s costly AI and robotics push.

title: Ford Just Made It Easier To Back Up Your House With An F-150 Hybrid Or Lightning
summary: The new solution means you don't need to use a mess of extension cords to back up your fridge or other appliances.
